"Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware" isn't a game at all, it's just an ad for [i]Diplomacy is Not An Option[/i]. Talk about store pollution... Misleading marketing like this is an abuse of the Steam storefront and the "free" category. The product this is advertising, [i]Diplomacy is Not An Option[/i] is a potentially not awful strategy game from Russia with rather low quality low poly "art" instead of proper graphics and a "horde survival" theme... but that's not really relevant, because "Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware" isn't Diplomacy is Not An Option, it's just an advert for it! Incorrectly published adverts are harmful.. they take up visibility that should instead be afforded to ethical developers who do the right thing. And it makes it harder for us to find those ethically made games. The purpose behind this advertisement is to convince you to spend [b]$30 USD[/b], your money, on the real product. This is a predatory and misleading abuse of the "Free" section of Steam... and we know there's a proper proccess the developer didn't follow. Let's look at the price and what kind of value this actually offers gamers. As an advertisement, this is only free in the same way that adverts on Youtube and banner ads in your browser are. This is a game demo that's been dumped on Steam to advertise another Steam store page in the hopes of raking in some cash. Just because advertisements are free, doesn't mean they're worth your time. It's important to understand there's a formal process to create a demo/page for a game which hasn't been followed here: https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/demos While it might seem like an innocuous mistake, publishing demos and advertisements as if they are full games is misleading and in some ways harmful. This advertisement is taking up marketing space and visibility that would be better made available to a developer that's done the right thing and created a full game. Instead, that visibility is given over to a demo/advert that's been published incorrectly and is polluting the marketplace. It's unclear if this mistake was made through incompetence or a deliberate intent to mislead gamers. Often developers may choose to incorrectly publish demo/advertisements as separate games as a cheap way to bypass paying Valve for marketing presence on the Steam front page, which may seem clever to them, but it's harmful behaviour and it's not good for gamers. Advertisements and incorrectly published demos don't add +1 to your game collector count, they aren't full games. It's impossible for me to recommend this incorrectly published advertising spam to gamers, you deserve better than adverts.

[h1]26.[/h1] .Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware（要战便战：共享软件）（2024） 1.首先这是个试玩版，主线2个任务和无限模式，其它玩法需要买完整版； 试玩版玩完给我的感觉是这个游戏目前玩法类似于红色警戒，不过是偏早期的战争文化，游戏感觉上来讲我还是更喜欢现代、未来化，打击感各方面更好一点； 2.主要是目前这个游戏试玩版它给人一种没有什么兵种能对应对面怪群的兵力，比如像红警有光棱坦克，能清怪群的，这个游戏清怪群需要靠宝石技能才有效果； 而且反馈给玩家打击感还需加强，比如肢解、血腥、各种声音和视觉效果反馈需要加强； 而且需要把兵种升级，我看宣传的完整版里面——后面还有其它僵尸部队； 还需要加入更多的武器，游玩目前玩起来挺有挑战性的吧； 3.我还希望加一种模式，给玩家无限时间去做准备，然后再来玩家主动选择来应对怪群，类似于塔防吧； 我看着还有一个沙盒模式，这个试玩版没有这个模式，对于喜欢这类对这样的玩家这个游戏来说可能挺好玩的； 4.玩这个游戏需要耐心，一般一场战役打下来一、两个小时左右，如果重来的话，起码要好几个小时，是需要精力和时间的; 目前来看可能并不是一款用来放松的游戏，可能因人而异；
